details.description:
Hamam Neem & Tulsi Bathing Soap brings the perfect blend of nature and tradition to your daily skincare routine. Infused with the natural goodness of Neem and Tulsi, this soap is crafted to purify and rejuvenate your skin. Neem's anti-fungal properties help combat pimple-causing germs, while Tulsi soothes and heals, ensuring a refreshing and holistic bathing experience. Ideal for all skin types, this paraben-free soap is a safe and gentle choice for men, women, and children.
Made with 100% natural ingredients, Hamam Neem & Tulsi Soap stands out as a trusted soap for those seeking a natural alternative to chemical-based products. Its legacy of natural care has made it a household favourite for generations. Whether you're looking for soaps for bath combo offers or exploring shop bath soap options, Hamam ensures effective skin protection and a rejuvenating cleanse.
This herbal soap is perfect for everyday use, offering a reliable solution for overall skin health. It caters to the needs of the entire family, making it a versatile addition to your bathing essentials. If you're searching for a soap base rooted in tradition or simply want a refreshing alternative to ordinary soaps, Hamam Neem & Tulsi Soap is the answer. Embrace the harmony of nature and heritage with this exceptional soap and enjoy a truly nourishing bathing experience every day.

Hamam harnesses one of nature's most potent protectors with 100 per cent pure neem oil and complements it with one of nature's most effective caregivers - Lemon Flower and Mint to bring together the best solution in a Soap for the summer. Hamam Lemon Flower soap with Mint and Pure Neem oil gives you fresh skin naturally. This Soap washes away germs and viruses and protects your skin naturally. It provides long-lasting freshness and fragrance. Hamam does not merely cleanse your skin, it purifies it. Hamam has consistently stood by its promise of protection for the last 89 years and continues to do so. Hamam harnesses the best of nature to provide safety and protection to your skin and that's why it has stood the test of time as a component of the wisdom mothers pass on to their children to keep them safe. Hamam aims to be your choice of companion as you get ready to take on the challenges of the world.
details.usageInstructions:
Wet the bar with water and lather on your palms.
Apply on your wet face & body and massage well.
Rinse thoroughly and pat skin dry.
For best results, use twice a day, morning and evening.

details.usageInstructions: Take a few drops of the liquid handwash, add water and rub the hands together to create lather. Rub the back of your hands as well as your fingertips and nails. Rinse with water and dry with a clean cloth.
